reply_text:
Now the Jack Ma, ARK and Q1 call pages.I found three new dated AI predictions from Musk in 2019, plus one that repeats the claim you already have. All of them are about Tesla's self-driving software. I found nothing dated in 2019 on when AGI or superintelligence will arrive.

**What I found**
- **ARK Invest podcast, recorded 13 Feb 2019:** ARK's write-up says he was certain Autopilot would be "feature-complete" for self-driving by the end of 2019. It also says he expected people could fall asleep in the car by the end of 2020, pending regulators. These are ARK's words, not his, except for the two-word quote "feature-complete", so I've marked both as coverage only.
- **Q1 2019 earnings call, 24 Apr 2019:** in his opening remarks Musk said Tesla expected 1 million robotaxis on the road in 2020. This is the same claim as your 2019-04-22 file, repeated two days later.
- **Q3 2019 earnings call, 23 Oct 2019:** Musk said an early-access release of feature-complete Full Self-Driving looked on track for the end of 2019. This one is in his own words in the call transcript.

**What I couldn't confirm**
- **Lex Fridman podcast, April 2019:** the transcript page stops partway through the episode, in the middle of a sentence about how many months drivers would still need to keep hands on the wheel. I haven't used it.
- **Debate with Jack Ma, Shanghai, Aug 2019:** Musk said AI "will be much smarter than the smartest human" but gave no timing, not even "soon". It didn't meet the rule for the undated list, so I left it out.
- **Lex Fridman podcast, Nov 2019:** "sooner rather than later" is about Neuralink, not about when superintelligence arrives, so it doesn't count either.

**Not checked:** I didn't open a transcript of Autonomy Day itself or of the January and July 2019 earnings calls. I used all 6 page openings and 10 of the 12 searches.
